messages:
maria_csm: Heads up — AtlasRetail onboarding stalled. 6 seats unclaimed, API keys not rotated, NPS 2 on week-1 survey. Renewal in 28 days. Thinking a quick 'grace route' play: temporary seat-reduction + 1:1 enablement + conditional usage credit. Thoughts?
ryan_csm_lead: Can you DM the raw usage numbers? and their committed qps? don't want blanket credits without signal.
maria_csm: Snapshot: daily calls down 42% over last 10 days. 2 blockers flagged by customer: "integration heavy" and "no SSO". Sketched flow here: https://redwood.share/atlas/flow
ashley_success_eng: We can offer a 2-week 50% seat hold + partner SSO template. Offer includes 1 dedicated SE session + office hours. Recommend the credit be conditional on attending and hitting activation metrics.
devin_ux: Suggest a low-friction packaging tweak: hide advanced connectors behind an 'advanced' toggle so they can start with core features. reduces perceived integration cost.
maria_csm: @retentionbot create play "atlas-grace-route-1" with tasks: 1) schedule SE session, 2) SSO pilot, 3) apply 20% usage credit conditional on activation. ETA 48h?
retentionbot: Created play atlas-grace-route-1. Checklist: SE session -> unassigned; SSO pilot -> unassigned; Credit -> unassigned. Play link: https://ops.redwood/plays/atlas-grace-route-1
ryan_csm_lead: :thumbsup: Maria — use the email template at /templates/grace-route-ask.md and cc me. tie credit to activation: >=10 API calls/day for 7 consecutive days.
maria_csm: Draft ready, sending in 30m. If they decline, fallback is a 'seat-reduction + extended free window' downgrade path; will create separate play for that.
ashley_success_eng: Quick tech ask — can we add a post-session smoke test? e.g. `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' https://api.redwood/v1/test` verify <50ms and sanity payload. If fails escalate to eng-oncall.
devin_ux: I'll assemble the 'starter kit' doc with step-by-step and link it into the play.
maria_csm: :rocket: Thanks all — executing now. I'll post status updates in #customer-health-atlas. Closing thread for now.
